description: This source file manages temporary object directories in a Git-like version control system. It handles creation, cleanup, migration, and environment setup for temporary object directories used during repository object management. The code ensures only one such directory exists at a time within a process, provides functions for environment variable management, directory setup, and object migration, and handles cleanup at program exit.

classes.name: tmp_objdir
classes.description: Represents a temporary object directory used during repository operations, holding references to the repository, path, environment variables, previous source, and a flag for destruction.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_free(struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a tmp_objdir instance.

methods.name: int tmp_objdir_destroy(struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Destroys a tmp_objdir, restores previous sources if needed, and cleans up the directory.

methods.name: void remove_tmp_objdir(void)
methods.description: Removes the globally held tmp_objdir instance at program exit.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_discard_objects(struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Removes the directory associated with the tmp_objdir, keeping the top-level directory.

methods.name: void env_append(struct strvec * env,const char * key,const char * val)
methods.description: Appends a value to an environment variable in a way compatible with shell parsing.

methods.name: void env_replace(struct strvec * env,const char * key,const char * val)
methods.description: Replaces an environment variable value with a new one.

methods.name: int setup_tmp_objdir(const char * root)
methods.description: Creates a subdirectory named 'pack' inside the specified root directory with permissions 0777.

methods.name: struct:tmp_objdir * tmp_objdir_create(struct repository * r,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Creates a new temporary object directory, initializes environment, and sets up cleanup handlers.

methods.name: int pack_copy_priority(const char * name)
methods.description: Assigns priority for copying packfiles based on filename suffixes.

methods.name: int pack_copy_cmp(const char * a,const char * b)
methods.description: Comparator for sorting pack files based on their priority.

methods.name: int read_dir_paths(struct string_list * out,const char * path)
methods.description: Reads directory entries (excluding hidden files) into a string list.

methods.name: int migrate_one(struct tmp_objdir * t,struct strbuf * src,struct strbuf * dst,enum finalize_object_file_flags flags)
methods.description: Migrates a single object file or directory from source to destination, adjusting permissions as necessary.

methods.name: int is_loose_object_shard(const char * name)
methods.description: Checks if a filename matches the pattern of a loose object shard (two hex digits).

methods.name: int migrate_paths(struct tmp_objdir * t,struct strbuf * src,struct strbuf * dst,enum finalize_object_file_flags flags)
methods.description: Recursively migrates all items within a directory, sorting by priority.

methods.name: int tmp_objdir_migrate(struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Migrates all objects from the temporary directory to the main object directory and cleans up.

methods.name: const char ** tmp_objdir_env(const struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Returns the environment variables associated with the tmp_objdir.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_add_as_alternate(const struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Adds the tmp_objdir as an alternate object directory in the repository.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_replace_primary_odb(struct tmp_objdir * t,int will_destroy)
methods.description: Replaces the primary object database with the tmp_objdir, saving previous source for restoration.

methods.name: struct:tmp_objdir * tmp_objdir_unapply_primary_odb(void)
methods.description: Reverts the primary object database to its original source, if replaced.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_reapply_primary_odb(struct tmp_objdir * t,const char * old_cwd,const char * new_cwd)
methods.description: Reapplies the primary object database override, adjusting paths as needed.
